flags.message: In record/documents/questions-presented.txt, the extractor captured a body subsection from pages 31-33 of the petition ('[The Questions Presented] In This Case Are Exceptionally Important...') instead of page (I) ('QUESTION S PRESENTED'), likely due to the intraword space in 'QUESTION S'. The actual Questions Presented were read from page (I) of petition.txt and sg-invited-brief.txt.
